sanskrit: सर्वधर्मान्परित्यज्य मामेकं शरणं व्रज । अहं त्वा सर्वपापेभ्यो मोक्षयिष्यामि मा शुचः ॥
hindiTranslation: सम्पूर्ण धर्मोंका आश्रय छोड़कर तू केवल मेरी शरणमें आ जा ।  मैं तुझे सम्पूर्ण पापोंसे मुक्त कर दूँगा, चिन्ता मत कर ॥
englishTranslation: Abandon all duties and take refuge in Me alone. I will free you from all wrongdoing; do not grieve.
essence: Total refuge ends the burden of fear.
speaker: Krishna
simpleMeaning: Let go of every lesser support and place yourself fully in Krishna's care. He promises freedom from all wrongdoing and asks Arjuna not to grieve.
simpleInsight: Let go of every other support and trust Krishna to free you from wrongdoing.
detailedMeaning: Arjuna has been broken open by doubt. After teaching him every path, Krishna gives the final secret instruction: stop clinging to every other support and come to Me alone. This is the closing turn of the entire dialogue.
modernRelevance: In a hospital corridor after the doctors have done all they can, a family sits with nothing left to arrange. Krishna's words meet that moment: take refuge in me, I will free you, do not grieve.
translationLiteral: सर्वधर्मान् (all duties) / परित्यज्य (having abandoned) / माम् (to Me) / एकम् (alone) / शरणम् (refuge) / व्रज (go) / अहम् (I) / त्वा (you) / सर्वपापेभ्यः (from all wrongdoing) / मोक्षयिष्यामि (will free) / मा (do not) / शुचः (grieve)
insight: Sarva-dharman parityajya: Krishna asks Arjuna to drop every other support, take refuge in him, and stop grieving.
